Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game! West Indies kept it late but have managed to drag themselves over the line and bag the 3-match T20I series 2-1 to start off this fascinating contest. The action now moves to the ODIs between the two sides. The 3-match ODI series begins on Wednesday, 10th March. The first game will begin at 0930 local (1330 GMT). Make sure you join us for that one. Till then, goodbye and take care!

For his brilliant performance, first with the ball and then with the bat, Fabian Allen is named the Player of the Match! Allen says that whenever the team asks him to do anything, he is always ready. Says that he is always prepared and when the skipper asked, he did the job. Tells that the pitch was on the slower side and he executed the plans nicely with the ball. Adds that he backs himself to play those big shots. On Holder not taking singles in the 18th over, Allen tells that it was him who went to his partner and told him that he is not comfortable playing Hasaranga. Tells that he backed himself for going for the big shot in the next over.

So near yet so far for Sri Lanka. Their bowlers, especially Wanindu Hasaranga and Lakshan Sandakan almost did the magic and turned things in their favor but not to be! Wanindu Hasaranga was once again the tormentor in chief as the hosts found him hard to face. He finished with 2/13. Lakshan Sandakan too grabbed 3 and gave away just 29. Dushmantha Chameera was brilliant too picking up a couple and going under 6 rpo. But Akila Dananjaya was too expensive, the gamble to give him the penultimate over backfired as he was taken to the cleaners by Fabian Allen. He finished with 0/53 from his 4 and that proved to be the difference between the two sides.

Chasing a modest total of 132, West Indies got off to a firing start as Lewis and Simmons started off with a bang. Lewis though departed after getting to a start. They were cruising in the Powerplay but that changed completely after that. The Sri Lankan spinners, led by Wanindu Hasaranga once again did the damage. The hosts struggled for partnerships and the dot balls along with wickets kept building pressure. Pooran settled, then just when he was taking off he too departed. Holder though kept his ice-cool composure, he stuck to his gameplan. He stuck at one end and ensured the game was within reach. It was Fabian Allen's day though. First with the ball and when 20 were needed off the final 2 overs, he destroyed Akila Dananjaya in the penultimate over and got his side over the line.

Phew! West Indies have done it the hard way but they have done it and won the series. Sri Lanka's wait for a T20I series win extends but commiseration for them. They made this a very close contest but just was not enough to see them over the line. They did all they could but were unable to get over the line.

SIX! Fabian Allen finishes it off in style! Take a bow! This is your day, Allen! First with the ball and then with the bat! Floated on middle, Allen smokes it high, very high, the ball kisses the skies and then comes down but on the other side of the ropes for a biggie. WEST INDIES WIN BY 3 WICKETS!
Full on middle, Holder pushes it through mid on for a run.
Short delivery on off, Allen punches it through point for a single.
SIX! That is clobbered! Loopy delivery on middle, Allen lofts it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Floated delivery on off, Allen looks to play the slog sweep but gets an outside edge. It goes towards short third man. The batsmen get two runs.
SIX! SMASHED! Short on the body, it is a delivery asking to be hit. Allen says thank you very much. He comfortably puts this leg break over the square leg fence for a biggie. 14 needed off 11 now.
Akila Dananjaya set to bowl the crucial penultimate over of the game.
On off, Holder pushes it back towards the bowler.
BEATEN! Flighted ball outside off, Holder looks to defend but misses it due to the sharp turn on this one.
Floated delivery on off, Holder pushes it back towards the bowler.

SIX! Into the orbit! Holder had the freedom in this delivery and he has made the most of it. Floated on middle and off, Holder slogs it over the cow corner fence and picks the bones out of that one for a biggie.
NO BALL! Hasaranga overstepped and here is a chance for Holder. Shorter on off, Holder blocks it. The umpire later on signals a NO BALL! Free Hit coming up! Big ball coming up!
Floated ball on middle, Holder pushes it through mid on but Holder denies the single.
Tossed up delivery on off, Holder pushes it through mid off but Holder does not take the single.
No hat-trick! Short on off, Allen manages to defend the hat-trick ball.
Fabian Allen walks out to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two-in-two for Sandakan and once again a Sri Lankan player has chance for a hat-trick in this series. Softest of dismissal this one and once again it is the googly. Flighted on the pads, Bravo looks to sweep but gets a top edge which goes straight to short fine leg. Akila Dananjaya there makes no mistake and takes the catch.
Dwayne Bravo joins Jason Holder out in the middle.

OUT! BOWLED! The wrong 'un does the trick for Sandakan. Powell had no idea what happened there! Lakshan bowls a googly which is short on middle and leg. Powell looks to defend but the ball turns back in, hits his inside edge and goes onto hit the stumps. 27 needed in 20!
SIX! That is hammered! Short ball on middle, Powell pulls it over long on. The fielder in the deep tries to take the catch but it goes over him for a maximum.
Full on off, Holder drives it through mid off for a single.
BEATEN! Short delivery outside off, Holder looks to cut but misses it.
A conference taking place now with Angelo Mathews, Wanindu Hasaranga, and Akila Dananjaya a part of it. Lakshan Sandakan is given the ball now. He will bowl out.
Tossed up ball on off, Powell defends it off the back foot.
Floated delivery on off, Holder looks to go big but gets it off the inner half of the bat. It goes towards fine leg. The batsmen take a single.
Full and down the leg side, Holder looks to flick but gets it off the pads. It goes towards the leg side.
Full on off, Powell sweeps it through square leg for a run.
Flighted delivery on middle, Holder pushes it through mid on for a single.
Tossed up delivery on off, Holder pushes it back towards the bowler.
Change in bowling! Wanindu Hasaranga is back on. 2/3 from his 2 overs. Just incredible!
Full on middle, Powell flicks it to mid-wicket.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off, Powell looks to defend but misses it due to the seam movement on this one.
Length delivery on off, Powell keeps it out.
Back of a length on off, Powell defends it off the front foot.
Rovman Powell is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Gem of a delivery from Chameera and Sri Lanka are not yet out of this game by any means. Good length ball pitching around off, Pooran looks to play it on the off side but he plays the wrong line. He looks to play it for the natural angle but the delivery held its line. Pooran misses his shot and the ball hits the top of off. 37 still needed off 34!
Length delivery on off, Holder pushes it towards covers for a run.
Change in bowling. Dushmantha Chameera is back for his final over.

SIX! Mistimed but still goes the distance! Slightly shorter around off, Pooran looks to smash it over long off. He does not time it well. It goes high in the air. It looks like it will go to the man at long off but Pooran gets enough on it to send it over the ropes.

SIX! KABOOM! Pooran goes downtown and gets the maximum! Floated on off, in the slot for Pooran. He frees his arms and smokes it over the bowler's head for a biggie. A welcome boundary for West Indies. They needed this as the pressure was building.

On middle and leg, Pooran pushes it through mid on for a single.

Short delivery on off, Pooran cuts it through point for a single.

Short delivery on off, Holder pushes it through mid off for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Holder pushes it to mid off.
The new man in is Jason Holder!

OUT! BOWLED! West Indies are losing control in this game. Another failure for the Universe Boss and Sandakan gets his first wicket of the game. Floated delivery on middle. Gayle, who had been quiet and patient so far decides to break the shackles. He clears his front leg and looks to go downtown, Chris Gayle style. He completely misses it though as first, he is early in his shot. Then he completely misreads the spin as well. The ball goes between his bat and pad to hit the middle and leg pole. 57 more needed and the run rate is creeping up.

Short ball on off, Pooran punches it through point for a single.

Flighted ball on off, Pooran drives it through point for a single.

WIDE! Down the leg side, Gayle looks to flick but misses it.
Floated delivery on middle, Gayle looks to flick but gets it off the pads. It goes towards the leg side.

Change in bowling! Lakshan Sandakan is into the attack for the first time this evening.
On off, Gayle pushes it through mid off for a run.

OUT! CAUGHT! Pollard departs without troubling the scorers. The move to bring on the pacer has paid its reward. Chameera hits the deck hard outside off. Just like Mathews, Pollard too looks to run it down behind point. The ball shapes away a bit and kisses the outside edge of Pollard's willow. Dickwella, behind the stumps, dives to his left and in front as the ball dies down to him. The Sri Lankan keeper does well to take the catch. The West Indies skipper departs. West Indies need 71 off 72 balls now.
Back of a length on off, Pollard defends it off the back foot.
Short delivery on off, Gayle punches it towards mid off for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Length delivery on middle, Gayle flicks it towards fine leg for a boundary.
Length delivery on off, Gayle defends it off the back foot.
WIDE! Bouncer on leg, Gayle ducks under it.
WIDE! Bouncer down the leg side, Gayle does well to duck under it.
Good length delivery on off, Gayle defends it off the back foot.
Tossed up delivery on off, Pollard defends it off the front foot.
Skipper. Kieron Pollard is out to bat and this is the battle of the series.

OUT! STUMPED! Wanindu strikes again and one has to question his choice of shot! Was it even necessary? They can easily see off Hasaranga as the required rate is not much but Simmons has gone looking for glory and departed. Flighted delivery outside off, Simmons wears his dancing shoes and comes down the track. The dancing shoes though are not equipped for this ball as Simmons misses his move. He swings his bat, connects with nothing. The West Indian opener is too far down the track and Dickwella does the rest.
Floated delivery on off, Simmons pushes it to point.
On middle, Simmons keeps it out.
Tossed up delivery on off, Gayle drives it through mid off for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Gayle blocks it off the front foot.
FOUR! 15 runs have come from the over! Short delivery on off, Simmons punches it through point for a boundary.
SIX! That is hammered! Short ball on middle, Simmons pulls it over square leg for a biggie.
FOUR! Nice shot! Full on off, Simmons drives it through mid off for a boundary.
Loopy delivery on off, Simmons pushes it to mid off.

Universe Boss time as Chris Gayle walks out to bat.

OUT! LBW! Wanindu once again weaving his magic and striking in his very first over. Is he going to turn this game around once again with his spinning webs? Floated delivery pitching on middle. Lewis looks to sweep it across the line. The ball pitches and keeps straight. Lewis misses his sweep and gets hit on the pad. A huge appeal follows and the umpire raises his finger. Lewis has a chat with Simmons but decides not to review it. Good call as it looked plum in front and replays later on confirm it.

NOT OUT! It is pitching outside leg! Flighted delivery on leg, Lewis looks to sweep but gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals for lbw but the umpire shakes his head. Sri Lanka review it. Ultra Edge shows there is no bat on it. Ball Tracker shows that it is pitching outside leg.
On middle, Lewis pushes it back towards the bowler.
Review time! An appeal for LBW against Evin Lewis has been turned down by the umpire but Angelo Mathews has decided to take it upstairs. Let's see what the replays have to say.

IN THE AIR AND DROPPED! Danushka Gunathilaka has dropped a sitter here. He must be doing much better than that. Almost a dream start for Hasaranga. He starts with a loopy ball, Simmons comes down the track and hits it against the breeze over mid-wicket. It does not go the distance and instead goes straight to deep mid-wicket. Gunathilaka there gets on his knees, the ball pops in and out of his hand.
Change in bowling. Angelo Mathews has decided to bring on his trump card. The Man of the Match from the last game, Wanindu Hasaranga is into the attack now.

Some issue with Lewis' pad as it is being changed now.

FOUR! Nicely swept! On middle, Lewis sweeps it towards fine leg. The fielder chases it but fails to stop it as it races away to the fence.

Floated ball outside off, Lewis looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes safely towards short third man.

On the pads, Simmons flicks it to the on side and keeps the strike. 2 gone, West Indies off to a good start. 20/0!

Good stop from Akila Dananjaya! Good length ball around off, Simmons opens the face of the bat in the last moment and runs it down fine towards third man. Akila Dananjaya runs to his left, puts a dive and saves a couple for his side.
Uppish but safe! Fuller outside off, Lewis swings it across the line. The ball hits the outer half of his bat and flies over backward point. Away from the third man fielder. Single taken.
On off, Simmons pushes it towards mid off and takes a run this time.
Fuller on off, Simmons blocks it.

FOUR LEG BYES! Poor start for Dushmantha Chameera! Defending a low total, you cannot give away freebies. On the pads, Simmons looks to flick but misses. The ball hits his pads and goes fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Who will bowl with the new ball from the other end?
Going down! Shortish on the pads, Lewis looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pad. There is an appeal but the umpire is unmoved.

SIX! Juts over and away! Short on off, Lewis gets on his back foot and pulls it with intent to the left of deep square leg. Ashen Bandara runs and dives to that side but the ball goes away from him and over the ropes. It took Sri Lanka more than 90 deliveries to get their first biggie but West Indies have the first one in the very first over.
Floated on off, Lewis drives it straight to cover.
Short on middle, Lewis defends it with a straight bat this time.
FOUR! Lewis is off with a bang! Short and wide outside off, Lewis slams it through point for a boundary. That will give him a lot of confidence!
West Indies and Simmons are off the mark! Shorter on off, Simmons whips it to mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a single.
